title: Merge from Debian unstable (LP: #2163661)
description:
Merge cryptsetup 2:2.8.7-1 from Debian unstable into stonking.

Dropped changes, included in Debian:
 - askpass: Fix FTBFS with glibc 2.43 (in 2:2.8.6-1)
 - d/tests/control: Add cpio autopkgtest dependency (in 2:2.8.6-2)
 - d/p/tests-Fix-tests-to-not-use-aes-generic-kernel-cipher-name.patch (upstream in 2.8.7)
 - d/p/Add-specific-error-for-failed-posix_fallocate-call.patch (upstream in 2.8.7)

Dropped changes, no longer needed:
 - busybox-initramfs dependency (reverted in 2:2.8.4-1ubuntu5, matches Debian)

Notable adaptation: d/tests/utils/cryptroot-common kernel extraction updated for
Debian's linux-image package split (linux-binary/linux-modules/linux-base debs),
keeping the Ubuntu-specific linux-image+linux-modules extraction.

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~levihackerman-102/+archive/ubuntu/cryptsetup-merge
